Setting: Phishing-Resistant Registration Bootstrap Available (Self-Service FIDO2 or TAP)
Recommendation: Give users with no phishing-resistant method a way to get one: either allow self-service FIDO2/passkey registration, or enable Temporary Access Pass so they can register FIDO2/a passkey without needing an existing strong method or their password. Without either, phishing-resistant rollout has no on-ramp.
